changelog: Sales lead page (#3853): a meeting planned with "Plan meeting" now re-renders the page (`router.refresh()` in `PlanMeetingButton` when no `onCreated` is given), so its history line shows at once — before, the page kept its old render and the history seemed one meeting behind until a reload.

en: Leads: a meeting planned from the lead page shows up in the history right away.
tr: Lead'ler: lead sayfasından planlanan toplantı, geçmişte hemen görünüyor.
de: Leads: Ein auf der Lead-Seite geplantes Meeting erscheint sofort im Verlauf.
